201:t_009:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「Watch out, $n! He's coming after you!」

201:t_009:12.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「His name is $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$. He's a man who's fought us many times, going after the $$スフィア$$s.」

201:t_009:13.en:
$$シン$$
「That guy...! How did he break the seal on $$ＺＯＮＥ$$!」

201:t_009:15.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That man is a being who is not permitted to die.」

201:t_009:18.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「To be precise, no matter how many times we defeat him, he comes back again and again...」

201:t_009:19.en:
$$シン$$
「And every time, he shows up in front of us to go after the $$スフィア$$s.」

201:t_009:20.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's why, to take away the source of his power, we sealed him and his unit inside the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ on Mars, a system that extracts $$次元力$$.」

201:t_009:21.en:
$$アマタ$$
「If a guy like that has come back again, that means...!」

201:t_009:22.en:
$$ランド$$
「Dammit...! It would've been better for both of us if he'd just stayed asleep!」

201:t_009:23.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$アサキム$$! How did you escape from $$ＺＯＮＥ$$!」

201:t_009:24.en:
$$アサキム$$
「There's no need for me to answer.」

201:t_009:26.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I'm sorry, but I'll deal with you all later.」

201:t_009:27.en:
$$勝平$$
「What's with that guy! Did he lose interest in the $$スフィア$$s!?」

201:t_009:33.en:
$$ランド$$
「He's after the $$サイデリアル$$ Reactors!」

201:t_009:35.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Isn't it obvious? To hunt the $$スフィア$$s.」

201:t_009:36.en:
$$アサキム$$
「The $$悲しみの乙女$$, the $$傷だらけの獅子$$, and the $$いがみ合う双子$$... Your existence is my insurance.」

201:t_009:37.en:
$n
「What...!? I can sense a $$スフィア$$ from him, too...!」

201:t_009:38.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$アサキム$$ hunts $$スフィア$$s... And he already possesses several of them.」

201:t_009:39.en:
$$ランド$$
「If I remember right... the $$偽りの黒羊$$, the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$, the $$知りたがる山羊$$... And he seems to have one more.」

201:t_009:40.en:
$$勝平$$
「Damn it! You've got that many and you still want more!?」

201:t_009:42.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Do you laugh at me and call me shameless? But this is who I am.」

201:t_009:43.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You pitiful servants understand too, don't you? What it is that I'm seeking.」

201:t_009:45.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Hurry up and come. It suits us fine that you're the one who showed up.」

201:t_009:47.en:
$$ランド$$
「That bastard! He's just ignoring us!」

201:t_009:48.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Stop, $$ランド$$! Depending on how you look at it, this is a chance!」

201:t_009:49.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Even I can tell, and I have nothing to do with the $$スフィア$$s... He's far stronger than he was before...」

201:t_009:50.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It means my time asleep wasn't wasted.」

201:t_009:51.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If we use his power, we could get out of this situation, too...」

201:t_009:53.en:
$$勝平$$
「I won't do it! Borrowing power from a guy like that!」

201:t_009:55.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I understand how you feel, but think about what we should do now.」

201:t_009:58.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Good boy. If you understand, that's enough.」

201:t_009:59.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, do not touch $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$...! Our targets are the Reactors, no matter what!」

201:t_009:62.en:
$n
「That's... the one who hunts $$スフィア$$s...」

201:t_009:63.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Now then, let's begin... the Feast of the End.」

201:t_010:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Significant proposal. Danger level: unmeasurable. I recommend immediate withdrawal.」

201:t_010:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Changing from proposal to warning. Danger level: unmeasurable. If we do not withdraw immediately, the probability of annihilation is high.」

201:t_010:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If we keep fighting like this... I can't see any chance of victory...」

201:t_010:7.en:
$n
「...Miss $$スズネ$$... Please get off $$ジェニオン$$...」

201:t_010:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n! You're planning to put me off $$ジェニオン$$ and throw your life away, aren't you!」

201:t_010:11.en:
$n
「But this is the only chance we have! I'll make a suicide attack with $$ジェニオン$$ and destroy that Imperial Palace!」

201:t_010:12.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You don't even understand what you're saying!」

201:t_010:13.en:
$n
「With the life of just one person like me, I can create the hope of getting peace back!」

201:t_010:14.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You! Do you think nobody would be sad if you died!」

201:t_010:15.en:
$n
「...I don't think that... But if it means I can save everyone...」

201:t_010:18.en:
$$スズネ$$
「For the world!? For everyone!? Live for me instead of things like that!」

201:t_010:20.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Please... Don't leave me all alone again...」

201:t_010:23.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$... You can't move, torn between the hope of saving the world and the despair of making someone precious to you grieve.」

201:t_010:24.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's your limit, Reactor of the defective $$スフィア$$.」
